title: The Fox in the Box
lines: Ben has a box. Six nuts are in it.
A red fox got in the box!
The fox bit a nut and sat.
The box tips. The fox can not get up.
"Can you fix it, Dad?" said Ben.
Dad tips the box up and the fox runs.
Ben has six nuts, but not a fox.

questions.ask: How many nuts were in the box?
questions.listenFor: Six. A number is easy to skim past, so have them find the word six on the page and touch it.

questions.ask: Why could the fox not get out?
questions.listenFor: The box tipped over with the fox inside. If they are stuck, read that line again and ask what happened to the box.

questions.ask: Do you think Ben was right to ask Dad for help? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer. Listen for a reason - the box was heavy, or a fox is a wild animal and not a pet. Both are good thinking.
